files.purpose: Storage.swift is the Services-layer persistence hub. It names the on-disk layout: library.json, threads/<UUID>.json and attachments/ under the store root (now taken from Core's StoragePaths.root), plus worktrees/ and patches/ under the home state directory <home>/<AppInfo.stateDirectoryName>. It also loads the library, reads, decodes and deletes thread documents, and imports attachments: a file copy, HEIC/HEIF to JPEG at quality 0.88, a pasted image stored as 'Pasted image.png', at most 8 files a message. It sweeps orphaned attachment files older than 24 hours. The same file defines DocumentPrefetch, a Mutex-guarded background decoder with a 12-entry / 16 MiB RecentCache, a 24-request queue and an urgent front-of-queue path. It also defines DiskWriter: one serial 'droppycode.storage.write' queue that coalesces saves per URL, writes atomically through JSONEncoder.storage, logs 'Droppy Code could not save %@: %@' on failure and, new in B3, remembers the byte size of each file's last asynchronous write.

B2->B3 NEW behaviour: DiskWriter keeps 'private let sizes = Mutex<[URL: Int]>([:])' (:333-334) and exposes 'func lastWrittenSize(of url: URL) -> Int?' (:336-338). write(_:to:) is now '@discardableResult ... -> Int?': it returns data.count after a successful atomic write (:381) and nil on an encode failure (:378) or a write failure (:384). files.purpose: TokenLedger.swift owns the daily AI-token spend behind the Token activity heatmap in Settings, General. TokenSpendTracker turns cumulative provider counters into positive per-event deltas. The @MainActor @Observable TokenLedger singleton merges three sources: legacy v1 per-day totals, live spend saved to token-activity-live-v2.json 2 seconds after the first unsaved record, and a one-time detached scan of Codex rollouts under ~/.codex/sessions and ~/.codex/archived_sessions. The scan tails 131072 bytes of each rollout, subtracts the total inherited on resume by reading up to 8 MiB of the head, and caches per-file fingerprints in token-activity-codex-v3.json, migrating the v2 file and the old 'droppycode.tokenActivity.codexFiles' preference. It reconciles live Codex spend recorded by earlier processes per rollout identity, newest day first. The file also defines TokenActivityMode (Daily/Weekly/Cumulative) and TokenActivityGrid.build, the current-year grid of Sunday-first week columns with fixed English month ticks.

B2->B3 (inheritedTotal :521-527, tailContribution :556-563): token_count lines are parsed with 'JSONValue.parse(lineData)', 'event["payload"]?["info"]', 'info["total_token_usage"]?["total_tokens"]?.int', 'info["last_token_usage"]?["total_tokens"]?.int ?? 0' and 'event["timestamp"]?.string'. B2 used 'JSONSerialization.jsonObject ... as? [String: Any]' with '(x as? NSNumber)?.intValue ?? x as? Int'. For the integer totals and string timestamps Codex writes, the results are the same.

Edge semantics that changed with the JSONValue switch (JSONValue.swift:26-45, :83-90): (a) a total_tokens or last_token_usage.total_tokens given as a JSON string such as "123" now parses through Int(String), where B2 rejected it; (b) a JSON boolean no longer converts (B2's 'as? NSNumber' turned true into 1), so a boolean total now skips the line and a boolean last counts as 0; (c) a finite non-integral number truncates toward zero as before; (d) a finite double outside Int's range now reaches Int(Double) and traps, where B2's NSNumber.intValue did not trap; (e) parse now allows fragments, but a non-object line still yields no payload and is skipped.
unresolved_questions: UNRESOLVED: nothing in the pinned source shows whether Codex ever writes total_tokens as a string, boolean, non-integral or out-of-range number. The B3 coercion differences affect only those shapes, and the Int(Double) trap case has no guard in the source.

PR-SETTINGS-137 and UI-SETTINGS-024 cite TokenLedger.swift:626-629 for monthNames. At B2 those lines were a blank line, the build(daily:mode:now:) signature and the first two calendar lines; monthNames was at B2 :623-625 (PR-USAGE-110 cites that correctly). At B3 it is :614-616.

Pre-existing, not a B2->B3 delta: the C# InheritedTotal (TokenLedger.cs:572-597) decodes the head lossily and splits the whole text. The Swift inheritedTotal (:502-533) parses raw line bytes and only examines lines that end in 0x0A, so a final unterminated line in the 8 MiB head is never parsed and invalid UTF-8 makes JSONSerialization fail. The port can therefore accept a line upstream skips. This is worth an adversarial check when the scanner is re-ported.
